quarterly_data.quarter: Galaxy Digital press release: Galaxy Provides Update on ERCOT Batch Zero Large Load (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ERCOT Batch Zero outcome: five Galaxy Texas data center projects received conditional classifications covering approximately 4.2 gigawatts of gross power capacity. Approved before the Batch Zero process and classified Batch Zero Base Load: Helios I (800 MW) and Helios II (830 MW, ERCOT approval in January 2026; part of the more than 1.6 GW already approved at Helios) - Helios II remains on schedule to energize in 2028 and its leasing is not impacted by the process. Expansion projects classified Batch Zero Studied Load (subject to capacity allocation): Caspian (700 MW gross; Galaxy had submitted it as Base Load but it was conditionally classified as Studied Load), Selene (900 MW) and Helios III (a 1,000 MW load request). ERCOT expects its audit of queued data center projects to take several months, and Galaxy says it will comply with any additional requirements from the Governor's August 3, 2026 directive. Galaxy's development pipeline now totals more than 5.7 GW across four sites, including a second 1,000 MW load request at Helios still progressing through ERCOT interconnection and Merlin, a new campus in McGregor, Texas with potential for 500 MW of gross power capacity. As developer, owner and operator, Galaxy holds the retail electricity service agreements, with power costs included in its hosting or lease arrangements with clients.
quarterly_data.figure: ~4.2 GW conditionally classified; Helios I 800 MW + Helios II 830 MW Base Load (Helios II energizes 2028); Caspian 700 MW, Selene 900 MW, Helios III 1,000 MW Studied Load; pipeline >5.7 GW
